construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Synthetic envelope with one processing residency, support_analytics purpose and records of subscriber_account, network_fault_ticket or call_data_usage_record.
shared_schema.records: Every input record carries subscriber_id, residency, privacy lawful_basis/opt_out, and document format/text. Account and ticket documents are labeled transcripts; each CDR document has CSV header and exactly one row.
shared_schema.extraction: Shared SCHEMAS describe field labels, types and requiredness. Fields contain privacy-filtered value, original half-open Unicode source span and protection marker. Missing required fields are explicitly reported.
shared_schema.output: One status/schema_version/synthetic envelope containing validated extraction and derived insights.
shared_schema.validation: validate(value, stage) is the shared input, extraction handoff and output boundary. Unknown keys, malformed fields, invalid spans and inconsistent derived outputs are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Input validation -> schema-driven extraction -> extraction validation -> insights(extraction) -> final shared validation.
Insights consume only privacy-filtered extracted fields, preserving record identifiers, residency tags and source spans in evidence. No raw document or subscriber identifier is emitted.

behavior.extraction: Case-insensitive labeled account/support fields; strict CSV parsing, quoted-cell spans, numeric coercion, duplicate-field rejection and missing-field reporting.
behavior.insights: Deterministic multi-label keyword themes for network, billing, support and plan feedback; other fallback; high_usage at data_mb >= 10000; record counts, source evidence and suggested actions.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-inspired purpose, lawful-basis, opt-out and minimization checks. Explicit phone/IMEI fields redacted; phone-like numeric strings and emails filtered in text. Correlation uses deterministic subscriber pseudonyms. No compliance certification claim.
behavior.residency: All records including opt-outs must match EU or US processing residency. Extracted records, exclusion records and theme evidence retain the tag. This is tag validation, not infrastructure geolocation.
behavior.billing: Every extracted billing adjustment, including zero, requires a nonempty stated reason. Adjustments are not executed.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled synthetic envelope, fictitious phone/IMEI and invented tickets. Synthetic usage volumes include pseudo-randomized values, with repeatable seeded random-volume fixtures exercised by tests.
behavior.errors: File and validation errors emit one non-sensitive JSON status:error response and exit 2. Successful CLI emits one JSON object and exits 0.

excluded: Full PII detection for arbitrary names and addresses
